scope_ar: الفجوة أداء وفهرسة حمولة؛ عزل المستأجر قائم بمرشح الخادم. لا ادعاء تسرب ولا تعديل مرشح البحث.
acceptance: New collection: create only after proven 404, then create metadata.tenant_id keyword index before first point upsert.
Existing collection missing the index: add only that index after vector dimension validation; preserve points, vector schema, optimizer and HNSW configuration.
Existing keyword index, including parameterized keyword/is_tenant/on_disk configuration: no index PUT, DELETE, collection recreation, or downgrade on repeated ensure_collection.
Missing payload_schema, malformed response or incompatible existing index type: fail clearly without destructive repair or treating uncertain state as absence.
Index creation uses wait=true and confirms the keyword postcondition; absent or wrong postcondition must not be reported as success.
Qdrant HTTP errors preserve status and exception compatibility; index creation or validation failure prevents point upsert and process-local BM25/chunk mutations.
Search still requests metadata.tenant_id match.any with trusted tenant and __global__; tenant index work neither broadens nor substitutes this filter.
Tests witness behavior and call ordering for new/existing/idempotent/error cases, not presence of implementation strings.

callgraph_sources.observation: only production caller of ensure_collection; embedding then ensure then upsert then BM25
storage exceptions converted to HTTP 502; sparse readiness invalidated only on successful ingest
read paths do not invoke ensure_collection
separate AsyncQdrantClient collection/create/upsert path; no call to canonical HTTP ensure_collection

deployment_boundary: No live Qdrant deployment or existing collection mutation is performed by this review.

A code repair reached only from ingest cannot imply all existing read-only/seeded collections are indexed after deployment; operator may call the explicit ensure path after verifying dimension, with no fake ingest required.
Payload index creation over old data does not prove HNSW filter-aware edges were rebuilt, latency improved, or any live tenant isolation receipt exists.
Do not change HNSW settings, drop/recreate a collection or index, reseed, rewrite payloads, or alter embedding provenance within this repair.
Any justified state transition is fixed at the repair SHA, not verified. Live verification needs a real Qdrant schema receipt and measurements on an authorized collection.

version_surface.decision: keyword baseline avoids requiring tenant-index extension; existing extra parameters must be preserved

primary_sources.supports: PUT collection/index, keyword field schema, wait semantics
keyword and wait available on unified version
nested dot notation, indexing cost, create before ingest, HNSW rebuilding is separate

findings.summary: Collecting tests/test_production_rag_kg_mcp.py with the selected v9 modules loads a colliding shared package and causes two shared.ai import failures; warm-index tests also skip without platform core path.
findings.patch_relation: Same two failures and four skips reproduced against unmodified production_qdrant.py on baseline main. Separate-process suites with explicit core path pass 69/69 without skips.
findings.action: Report honestly; do not expand payload-index repair to unrelated test-import setup.
